title: ClawdBot Enterprise System Configuration Manual
subtitle: Complete Setup Guide with Local LLM and n8n Integration
author: Enterprise AI Solutions Team
overview: This comprehensive manual provides detailed instructions for deploying ClawdBot Enterprise in an organizational environment with local Large Language Model (LLM) infrastructure and n8n workflow automation integration. The guide covers hardware requirements, software installation, security configuration, and operational procedures for enterprise-grade AI assistant deployment.
specifications: **System Requirements:** Mac Studio M3 Ultra (recommended) or equivalent x64 system with 32GB+ unified memory, 1TB+ SSD storage, and macOS 13+ or Ubuntu 22.04+. **Software Stack:** Ollama local LLM platform, ClawdBot Enterprise, n8n workflow automation, Docker containers, and Node.js 18+ runtime environment. **Network Requirements:** HTTPS connectivity for external integrations, internal network access for local services, and secure API endpoints for inter-service communication.

sections.title: Architecture Overview
sections.content: The ClawdBot Enterprise architecture implements a three-tier hybrid system combining local AI processing, cloud integrations, and workflow automation. Tier 1 provides local LLM processing via Ollama for sensitive data handling. Tier 2 manages intelligent routing between local and cloud services based on security classifications. Tier 3 integrates with external systems through n8n workflow automation for seamless enterprise operations.

sections.title: Hardware Preparation
sections.content: Prepare the deployment hardware according to enterprise specifications. For Mac Studio M3 Ultra: verify 32GB+ unified memory, configure dedicated storage partitions, enable hardware security features, and optimize thermal management. For alternative hardware: ensure NVIDIA GPU support for acceleration, configure adequate cooling, and verify compatibility with containerized deployments.

sections.title: Local LLM Setup (Ollama)
sections.content: Install Ollama platform for local LLM processing: Download from official repository, configure service daemon, set up model storage directories, and optimize for enterprise security. Deploy primary models: Llama 3.1 8B for general processing, Llama 3.1 70B for complex analysis, Code Llama 7B for technical support, and Mistral 7B for rapid responses. Configure memory management, GPU acceleration, and model caching strategies.

sections.title: ClawdBot Enterprise Installation
sections.content: Deploy ClawdBot Enterprise platform: Install Node.js runtime environment, configure enterprise license and authentication, set up department-specific agents, implement security policies and access controls, and establish audit logging systems. Configure hybrid routing engine, integrate communication channels (Discord, Telegram, Slack), and establish monitoring and alerting systems.

sections.title: n8n Workflow Integration
sections.content: Implement n8n workflow automation for enterprise integration: Install n8n platform via Docker, configure database backend (PostgreSQL recommended), set up workflow templates for common operations, establish API connections to enterprise systems (CRM, ERP, ITSM), and implement secure credential management. Create automated workflows for meeting scheduling, document processing, report generation, and system monitoring.

sections.title: Security Configuration
sections.content: Implement enterprise security framework: Configure SSL/TLS certificates, set up authentication systems (LDAP/SAML integration), implement role-based access controls, establish data classification policies, and configure audit logging. Deploy network security measures including firewall rules, VPN access, and intrusion detection systems. Implement backup and disaster recovery procedures.

sections.title: Department Configuration
sections.content: Configure department-specific AI agents: Set up HR agent with local-only processing for employee data, configure Finance agent with maximum security for financial information, deploy IT agent with hybrid processing capabilities, establish Marketing agent with cloud integration permissions, and create Executive agent with strategic analysis features. Customize knowledge bases, security policies, and communication channels for each department.

sections.title: Testing and Validation
sections.content: Execute comprehensive testing procedures: Validate local LLM functionality and performance benchmarks, test ClawdBot agent responses and security controls, verify n8n workflow automation and enterprise integrations, conduct security penetration testing, and perform load testing under various scenarios. Document test results and implement necessary optimizations.

examples: **Agent Query Example:** POST /api/v1/llm/query with payload {'query': 'Analyze Q1 financial performance', 'model': 'llama-3.1-70b', 'security_context': 'finance-confidential'}. **Workflow Trigger:** Automatic meeting transcription workflow triggered by calendar integration, processes audio via Whisper, generates summary using local LLM, and distributes via configured channels. **Security Audit:** GET /api/v1/security/audit?date_range=2026-01-01:2026-01-31&department=HR returns comprehensive access logs for HR department activities.
troubleshooting: **Common Issues:** Ollama model loading failures (check memory allocation and model file integrity), ClawdBot agent unresponsive (verify service status and restart if necessary), n8n workflow errors (check API credentials and network connectivity), security authentication failures (validate LDAP/SAML configuration), and performance degradation (monitor resource usage and optimize model allocation). **Maintenance Procedures:** Regular model updates, security patch deployment, workflow optimization, and performance monitoring.
maintenance: **Daily Tasks:** Monitor system health metrics, review security audit logs, verify backup completion, and check workflow execution status. **Weekly Tasks:** Update knowledge bases, review user feedback, optimize performance settings, and conduct security reviews. **Monthly Tasks:** Deploy software updates, perform comprehensive testing, review capacity planning, and update documentation. **Quarterly Tasks:** Conduct security audits, review architecture optimization, plan upgrades, and assess business requirements.
